description: Mark a previously registered `session_id` as the current account label, for your own bookkeeping across a conversation. The registry is a label only: it does not change which Redfin account requests use. Every redfin tool call goes through whichever browser tab the ContextMint Bridge extension is signed into; to read a different account, sign that tab into it.
name: redfin_set_active_session
title: Set the active Redfin session
